info.description:
High-performance package manager proxy/mirror server supporting Maven, NPM, APT, Docker Registry, PyPI, YUM, and APK

ProxyND provides caching, authentication, and enterprise features for package management.
Enterprise features include RBAC, audit logging, analytics, security scanning, and alerting.
